text: Existing decentralized organizations, coordinating through capital-weighted mechanisms in which influence tracks transferable holdings, are computative labor forces operating without reputation institutions — a standing instance of the neoclassical configuration against which the computative alternative can be measured.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, From Neoclassical to Computative Labor: Foundations for a Testable Theory of Reputation Governance in the Agent Economy (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6890879

isBasedOn.name: From Neoclassical to Computative Labor: Foundations for a Testable Theory of Reputation Governance in the Agent Economy

abstract: They are, in effect, computative labor forces operating without the reputation institutions the computative account holds to be necessary, which makes them a standing instance of the neoclassical configuration against which the computative alternative can be measured.

value: capital-weighted DAOs as the observable comparison pole
